label: Early copy-phase steps (delimiter + first two recalls) of longer sequences
explanation: Almost never active in the original phase (0.2% of mass). Fires at the <DEL> step and the first copy steps: recall_idx 0/1/2 hold 28/39/24% of the mass, peaking at recall_idx 1 (step right after <DEL>), and it falls off sharply from recall_idx 3 onward. Rate goes up with sequence length (L=9 rate 7.5% vs L=3-4 about 1.3%), so it is roughly tied to many outputs still remaining (to_go >= 5). The predicate covers about 85% of activation mass, but precision is low (about 26%): within this window, whether it fires depends on sequence content. Out_tok k/u/2/y/q and next_out r/g/l show higher rates, and many top examples have r at original position 3, but adding token conditions only nudges F1 (0.39 to 0.44) and no clean content rule was found. Does not fire on original-phase inputs or on late copy steps.
